en.label: Life / self-configuration
en.definition: How the chart organizes self-direction, role orientation and the way a person meets situations. It is a structural domain, not a fixed identity claim.

zh-Hans.label: 命宫｜自我结构
zh-Hans.definition: 命盘中自我方向、角色取向与面对情境方式的结构领域；它不是固定人格或命运断言。

en.label: Peers / sibling network
en.definition: Peer, sibling and lateral-support relationships, including cooperation, comparison and shared resources.

zh-Hans.label: 兄弟宫｜同辈网络
zh-Hans.definition: 同辈、手足与横向支持关系，包括合作、比较与共享资源。

en.label: Partnership domain
en.definition: Close partnership, reciprocity, commitment patterns and one-to-one relational structure. It does not predict relationship outcomes.

zh-Hans.label: 夫妻宫｜伴侣关系
zh-Hans.definition: 亲密伴侣、互惠、承诺与一对一关系结构；不预测关系结果。

en.label: Generativity domain
en.definition: Generativity, care, offspring-related roles and projects or outputs that extend beyond the self.

zh-Hans.label: 子女宫｜生成与延续
zh-Hans.definition: 生成、照护、子女相关角色，以及由自身延伸出去的项目与产出。

en.label: Resource domain
en.definition: Material resources, exchange, earning/using patterns and stewardship of what can be allocated. It is not financial advice or a wealth forecast.

zh-Hans.label: 财帛宫｜资源领域
zh-Hans.definition: 物质资源、交换、取得与使用资源的模式，以及可分配资源的管理；不是理财建议或财富预测。

en.label: Body and maintenance domain
en.definition: The body, maintenance load, routines and recovery context as a symbolic domain. It does not diagnose illness or establish medical facts.

zh-Hans.label: 疾厄宫｜身体与维持
zh-Hans.definition: 身体、维持负荷、日常节律与恢复情境的象征领域；不诊断疾病，也不建立医疗事实。

en.label: External environment / mobility
en.definition: Movement, external environments, relocation, exposure to unfamiliar contexts and how the chart engages the world beyond the familiar base.

zh-Hans.label: 迁移宫｜外部环境与移动
zh-Hans.definition: 移动、外部环境、迁移、陌生情境，以及命盘如何接触熟悉基础之外的世界。

en.label: Network / collaborators
en.definition: Friends, colleagues, collaborators, communities and reciprocal network participation.

zh-Hans.label: 交友宫｜网络与协作
zh-Hans.definition: 朋友、同事、协作者、社群与互惠网络参与。

en.label: Work / public role
en.definition: Work, vocation, responsibility, contribution and public-role structure. It does not guarantee status or career outcomes.

zh-Hans.label: 官禄宫｜工作与公共角色
zh-Hans.definition: 工作、职业、责任、贡献与公共角色结构；不保证职位或事业结果。

en.label: Base / home / holdings
en.definition: Home base, property/holdings, living environment and the material foundation that supports continuity.

zh-Hans.label: 田宅宫｜基础与居所
zh-Hans.definition: 居所、资产持有、生活环境与支持持续性的物质基础。

en.label: Inner resources / reflective life
en.definition: Inner resources, reflective life, rest, satisfaction and the subjective capacity to metabolize experience.

zh-Hans.label: 福德宫｜内在资源与反思
zh-Hans.definition: 内在资源、反思生活、休息、满足感，以及消化经验的主观容量。

en.label: Lineage / authority support
en.definition: Parents, lineage, elders, institutions and inherited or formal support relationships.

zh-Hans.label: 父母宫｜家系与权威支持
zh-Hans.definition: 父母、家系、长辈、制度，以及继承性或正式支持关系。

en.label: Central coordination
en.definition: Central coordination, integration, stewardship and role-centered organization.

zh-Hans.label: 紫微｜中心协调
zh-Hans.definition: 中心协调、整合、统筹与以角色为中心的组织能力。

en.label: Analysis and adaptation
en.definition: Analysis, planning, pattern detection, adjustment and responsive problem-solving.

zh-Hans.label: 天机｜分析与适应
zh-Hans.definition: 分析、规划、模式辨识、调整与回应式解决问题。

en.label: Visibility and outward contribution
en.definition: Visibility, outward expression, illumination, contribution and active engagement with others.

zh-Hans.label: 太阳｜可见性与外向贡献
zh-Hans.definition: 可见性、向外表达、照亮、贡献与主动参与他人。

en.label: Resource discipline and execution
en.definition: Execution, resource discipline, measurable action, prioritization and material organization.

zh-Hans.label: 武曲｜资源纪律与执行
zh-Hans.definition: 执行、资源纪律、可衡量行动、优先次序与物质组织。

en.label: Ease and adaptive receptivity
en.definition: Ease, receptivity, comfort-seeking, social softness and adaptation through reduced friction.

zh-Hans.label: 天同｜和缓与适应性接纳
zh-Hans.definition: 和缓、接纳、舒适取向、社交柔性，以及通过降低摩擦进行适应。

en.label: Boundaries and complex evaluation
en.definition: Boundaries, standards, attraction/aversion, ethical tension and complex evaluation of what is acceptable.

zh-Hans.label: 廉贞｜边界与复杂评估
zh-Hans.definition: 边界、标准、趋近与排斥、伦理张力，以及对可接受范围的复杂评估。

en.label: Stewardship and stability
en.definition: Stewardship, storage, continuity, resource holding and stabilizing what has already been established.

zh-Hans.label: 天府｜承载与稳定
zh-Hans.definition: 统筹承载、储存、连续性、资源持有，以及稳定已经建立的结构。

en.label: Inward reflection and reserve
en.definition: Inward reflection, receptivity, reserve, cultivation and attention to subtle or private conditions.

zh-Hans.label: 太阴｜内向反思与储备
zh-Hans.definition: 内向反思、接纳、储备、培育，以及对细微或私人情境的关注。

en.label: Appetite and exploration
en.definition: Appetite, exploration, social exchange, experimentation and attraction toward varied experience.

zh-Hans.label: 贪狼｜欲求与探索
zh-Hans.definition: 欲求、探索、社交交换、实验，以及被多样经验吸引的倾向。

en.label: Questioning and discourse
en.definition: Questioning, debate, language, clarification, ambiguity and the need to examine contested information.

zh-Hans.label: 巨门｜质疑与言说
zh-Hans.definition: 质疑、辩论、语言、澄清、模糊性，以及检视争议信息的需求。

en.label: Mediation and role order
en.definition: Mediation, support, procedural order, role coordination and maintaining workable relational arrangements.

zh-Hans.label: 天相｜协调与角色秩序
zh-Hans.definition: 协调、支持、程序秩序、角色配合，以及维持可运作的关系安排。

en.label: Protection and principled oversight
en.definition: Protection, principles, oversight, repair and maintaining standards across time.

zh-Hans.label: 天梁｜保护与原则监督
zh-Hans.definition: 保护、原则、监督、修复，以及跨时间维持标准。

en.label: Decisive pressure and cutting action
en.definition: Decisive pressure, concentrated action, risk-bearing and the capacity to cut through delay or ambiguity.

zh-Hans.label: 七杀｜决断压力与切入行动
zh-Hans.definition: 决断压力、集中行动、承担风险，以及切开拖延或模糊的能力。

en.label: Disruption and restructuring
en.definition: Disruption, dismantling, restructuring, renewal and the willingness to replace an exhausted configuration.

zh-Hans.label: 破军｜破旧与重组
zh-Hans.definition: 破旧、拆解、重组、更新，以及替换失效结构的倾向。

en.label: Coordinating assistance
en.definition: Practical assistance, coordination and support that helps a structure operate more smoothly.

zh-Hans.label: 左辅｜协同辅助
zh-Hans.definition: 实际协助、协调与让结构更顺畅运作的支持。

en.label: Relational support
en.definition: Relational support, cooperation and complementary help supplied through people or networks.

zh-Hans.label: 右弼｜关系支持
zh-Hans.definition: 由人际或网络提供的关系支持、合作与互补帮助。

en.label: Structured expression and learning
en.definition: Structured expression, learning, documentation, ordering information and making ideas legible.

zh-Hans.label: 文昌｜结构化表达与学习
zh-Hans.definition: 结构化表达、学习、记录、整理信息与让想法更清楚可读。

en.label: Nuanced expression and cultural sensitivity
en.definition: Nuanced expression, aesthetic/cultural sensitivity, symbolic communication and modulation of tone.

zh-Hans.label: 文曲｜细腻表达与文化感受
zh-Hans.definition: 细腻表达、审美与文化感受、象征沟通与语气调节。

en.label: Formal facilitation
en.definition: Facilitation through formal channels, timely support, access or recognition from established structures.

zh-Hans.label: 天魁｜正式助力
zh-Hans.definition: 来自正式渠道、既有结构的及时支持、通达或认可。

en.label: Relational facilitation
en.definition: Facilitation through interpersonal responsiveness, soft support and useful relational openings.

zh-Hans.label: 天钺｜关系助力
zh-Hans.definition: 通过人际回应、柔性支持与有用关系入口形成的助力。

en.label: Resource flow / attraction
en.definition: Increases attraction, access, resource flow or ease around the transformed star. It does not guarantee gain.

zh-Hans.label: 化禄｜资源流入与趋近
zh-Hans.definition: 提高与该星曜相关的趋近、通达、资源流动或顺畅度；不保证获得。

en.label: Activation / responsibility
en.definition: Intensifies activation, responsibility, control, pressure to act or capacity to take charge around the transformed star.

zh-Hans.label: 化权｜激活与责任
zh-Hans.definition: 增强该星曜相关的激活、责任、控制、行动压力或承担能力。

en.label: Articulation / qualification
en.definition: Emphasizes articulation, legibility, qualification, recognition or the ability to make a pattern understandable.

zh-Hans.label: 化科｜表达与资格化
zh-Hans.definition: 强调表达清晰、可识别、资格化、认可或让模式更容易被理解。

en.label: Friction / entanglement
en.definition: Marks friction, entanglement, constraint, overinvestment or a point requiring closer review. It is not a prediction of harm.

zh-Hans.label: 化忌｜摩擦与纠结
zh-Hans.definition: 标记摩擦、纠结、限制、过度投入或需要更仔细检视的位置；不是伤害预测。
